courses.prereqText: Enrolment in the Diploma in Management and Organizational Studies with Work Placement and approval of and acceptance into a work placement work term.

courses.title: INTEGRATED ANALYSIS AND DECISION MAKING IN ACCOUNTING
courses.prereqText: MOS 3361A/B, MOS 3370A/B, and enrolment in 4th year of a BMOS Accounting or Finance module. Pre- or Co-requisite(s): MOS 3363A/B, MOS 3362A/B.

courses.title: ADVANCES IN SUSTAINABILITY AND CONSUMER BEHAVIOUR
courses.prereqText: At least two of MOS 3321F/G, MOS 3420F/G, MOS 3423F/G. Priority will be given to Huron University College students registered in the Honours Specialization in Marketing and Sustainability. Enrollment from students registered in MOS modules other than Marketing and Sustainability is given by special permission of the course instructor only.

courses.title: INDEPENDENT STUDY COURSE IN MANAGEMENT AND ORGANIZATIONAL STUDIES
courses.prereqText: Permission of the instructor and enrolment in 4th year of any MOS Module. Application required (see DAN Management and Organizational Studies for further information).

courses.title: INDEPENDENT STUDY COURSE IN MANAGEMENT AND ORGANIZATIONAL STUDIES
courses.prereqText: Permission of the instructor and enrolment in 4th year of an Honours Specialization in BMOS or in 3rd or 4th year of Animal Ethics and Sustainability Leadership Major or Minor.

courses.title: HONOURS THESIS COURSE IN MANAGEMENT AND ORGANIZATIONAL STUDIES
courses.prereqText: Permission of the instructor and enrolment in 4th year of an Honours Specialization in Consumer Behavior or Human Resource Management in BMOS.
